criteria.check: Lock defaults on (src/cma/firm.py FirmConfig offline_lock=True; a missing file means the defaults; a malformed file raises FirmConfigError). Hosted clients are built only on an unlocked reading (src/cma/llm.py _require_unlocked_now), with max_retries=0 and a per-request HTTP hook that follows no redirect (_checked_http, HostedLLM._check). The MCP run methods, both ASGI factories, LockCheckedASGI (lifespan, 503, websocket close) and every tool (_statement) read the lock; main() reads it first (src/cma/mcp_server.py). Evidence records offline_lock, resume_offline_lock and draft_resume_offline_lock (src/cma/graph.py _egress). Revision 32 untraced run: the verify-223 gap is closed. stream and astream now wrap the generator's creation, every next()/__anext__ and close() in _untraced_step (src/cma/graph.py:767-829), which clears tracing_v2_callback_var, strips inherited LangChainTracers and enters langsmith.tracing_context(enabled=False) afresh inside each step, so a context the caller enters between steps is overridden while graph code runs. LangGraph runs node tasks only within a tick inside that __anext__/next; sync executor submissions copy the context at submit (langgraph/pregel/_executor.py), and async tasks are created inside the step (langgraph/pregel/main.py:3550-3570). invoke, ainvoke, stream_events v3 (main.py:3659, 3714) and the Runnable batch and transform paths all reach the subclass's stream/astream (main.py:4003-4205). invariants-5.log:139-143 passed: the with_config copy test, the tracing_v2 context tests for invoke and stream, and the between-steps tests for sync and async.

draft_prompt (src/cma/graph.py) writes only Account: Applicant, the period, met.as_table (fixed method strings, src/cma/metrics.py:295) and rules_table(for_prompt=True). A custom rule that is not the shipped rule whole (_is_shipped compares description, metric, op, threshold, bands, on_fail and when_missing) is masked as (custom id)/(custom rule)/(custom requirement) with detail '-'. A shipped rule's detail uses the shipped spellings. Policy details come from fixed templates (src/cma/policy.py:93, 107). Redraft feedback is REDRAFT_LABEL plus redraft_ids, restricted to table ids, and the guard's reasons are no longer sent. The P5 tests in invariants-5.log passed.

Under revision 33's scope, a prompt holds only text the tool writes (labels, headings, fixed method and detail sentences, custom masks, shipped rule text) and values the case decides (period, figure values, outcomes). test_p5_no_prompt_carries_line_level_text (every archetype, every profile, hallucinate on and off, redrafts included), the custom-policy id, description and limit tests and test_p5_cli_custom_policy_prompts_carry_no_sentinel all passed in the invariants tier.

The p18 tests passed in invariants-5.log. They cover: the hosted model refused under the lock with no client and no socket; an existing client refused once the lock is on; the SDK sending one attempt per check; the MCP start paths, ASGI factories and tools refused; the real HTTP start binding no socket under the lock; a saved app refusing at start-up and on requests; a resume reading firm.yaml as it resumes; tracers handed in or inherited taken out; with_config copies; and tracing contexts entered before the run or between stream steps. With R29's untraced-run gap closed, the property holds within the revision 32 scope.
